Package index

Scan & graph

Read an installed library or renv lockfile into a tidy inventory and build an igraph dependency DAG with cycle and diamond helpers.

scan_library() bw_example()
Scan an R library or renv lockfile into a package inventory
build_dep_graph()
Build a dependency graph from a library or lockfile
bw_cycles()
Find dependency cycles in a graph
bw_diamonds()
Find diamond (shared) dependencies in a graph
bw_graph_data()
Convert a dependency graph to node/edge data frames

Diagnose & report

Run the full diagnostic pipeline, render a static HTML report, or launch the interactive Shiny dashboard.

diagnose()
Run the full buildwright diagnosis in one call
report()
Render a buildwright report or launch the dashboard
run_dashboard()
Launch the interactive buildwright dashboard

Conflicts & system requirements

Detect missing packages, version conflicts, and cycles; map packages to system libraries and flag those that are absent on the host.

detect_conflicts()
Detect unsatisfiable dependency constraints
check_sysreqs()
Map packages to system requirements and flag likely-missing libraries
bw_sysreq_library_db() bw_sysreq_package_map()
The buildwright system-requirements knowledge base

Install simulation & hooks

Predict install failures in dependency-first order and gate renv/pak installs as a fail-fast pre-install hook.

simulate_install()
Simulate an installation and predict failures before running it
bw_preinstall_check()
Pre-install health gate for renv / pak workflows

Helpers & data

Access bundled fixture lockfiles for examples and tests, and retrieve the current dashboard diagnosis object.

scan_library() bw_example()
Scan an R library or renv lockfile into a package inventory
bw_dashboard_data()
Diagnosis currently handed to the dashboard
